label: Alibaba.com
terms_note: Seller must be a paid Gold Supplier (GGS) member; the developer registers as a GGS developer and each app is reviewed by Alibaba before API permissions are granted; API use free in beta; no numeric rate limit published — calls are counted per developer account with e-mail warnings before suspension; no sandbox mentioned.

discovery.auth: oauth2 (app key + app secret, seller authorises the app → code → access_token + refresh_token via /auth/token/create)
sdks: official call examples for Java / PHP / .NET / cURL / Python / C / NodeJS per endpoint (developer.alibaba.com article 118416)

rate_limits: "up to 10 million calls per day" platform-wide claim (developer.alibaba.com, via search)

reference.verdict: **Verdict** — has_api: **yes**.Confidence: **medium** — official getting-started + overview pages opened (one through r.jina.ai); the API reference is JS-render
auth: 1. Register an Alibaba.com account and sign up as a GGS developer (Gold Supplier membership is paid).
2. Register an application in a category; Alibaba admins review it; the app receives an App Key + App Secret ('the unique identity of your application on the Alibaba.com Open Platform').
3. Request the API permissions the app needs.
4. The supplier (seller) authorises the app; exchange the `code` at `/auth/token/create` for `access_token`, `refresh_token`, `expires_in`, `refresh_expires_in`, `seller_id`, `user_id`, `country`.
5. Every call carries the access token (refresh when `refresh_expires_in` > 0).

endpoints.notes: `code` → access_token, refresh_token, expires_in, account platform, country, seller_id, user_id
documented as a step-by-step guide; individual method names not readable in this pass
'more than 20 endpoints' covering product + order information

reference.limits: No numeric limit published; Alibaba counts the total calls of all API keys on the developer account and e-mails before suspending excess usage (developer.alibaba.com overview). - Paid GGS (Gold Supplier) membership is a precondition for both the seller and the developer registration. - Every application is reviewed by Alibaba admins before API permissions are granted (access = apply). - API is free in the beta described by the overview; commercial terms otherwise those of the GGS membership.
mcp_sdk: SDK: official call examples for Java / PHP / .NET / cURL / Python / C / NodeJS per endpoint (developer.alibaba.com article 118416)

fields.name: app_key
fields.help: App Key of your Alibaba.com Open Platform app (https://openapi.alibaba.com/ App Console; admin-reviewed).

fields.name: app_secret
fields.help: App Secret of the same app; signs every call: uppercase hex HMAC-SHA256 over the API path without '/rest' (e.g. /alibaba/order/get) + the parameters sorted by name as name+value (docId=61). Never sent on the wire.

fields.name: access_token
fields.help: access_token from the authorisation-code exchange /auth/token/create (https://openapi.alibaba.com/doc/api.htm#/api?cid=4&path=/auth/token/create). It expires after expires_in seconds; renew it with /auth/token/refresh (a signed call) and update this value — the runtime does not refresh it.

me.note: alibaba order list (role=seller, one row): verifies the app signature and the seller's access_token.

list_orders.note: alibaba order list with role=seller: the GGS seller's orders (trade_id, trade_status, create/modify timestamps in ms). `status` is an Alibaba trade status (e.g. unpay, undeliver, delivering, completed; list at docId=131); `since` filters by creation time. Amounts and products: /alibaba/order/get (not mapped for channels).

set_inventory.note: Edit Product Inventory: sets the PRODUCT-level real-time inventory of `listing_id` (product_id). Check `success`/`error` (result.success, result.message); SKU-level stock (sku_inventory) is not mapped.

update_listing.note: Edit Product Price: sets a single USD tier (from 1 unit) as the product-level price of `listing_id` ('Currency, USD only'). Tiered, range and SKU prices beyond that are not mapped; title/description edits are not mapped.

end_listing.note: Change listing status (action=offline): takes product `listing_id` offline; `success` is false with per-product errors otherwise.

not_offered.create_listing: Products are published through /icbu/product/schema/add, which takes the category's JSON schema document ('/alibaba/icbu/product/schema/get' first, https://openapi.alibaba.com/doc/api.htm#/api?cid=1&path=/icbu/product/schema/add&methodType=GET/POST); the vocabulary's title/price/quantity inputs cannot fill a category schema.
not_offered.mark_shipped: Ggs one Order Shipping (/alibaba/v2/order/shipping, https://openapi.alibaba.com/doc/api.htm#/api?cid=12&path=/alibaba/v2/order/shipping&methodType=GET/POST) requires 'logistics_type' (Required, documented only as 'Logistics Type', no values listed) and a 'service_provider' code from alibaba.seller.order.shipping.channels; a valid request cannot be built from order_id/carrier/tracking_number.

adapter.terms: Alibaba.com Open Platform: https://openapi-api.alibaba.com/rest{api_path}?app_key&timestamp(ms)&sign_method=sha256&access_token&…&sign, where sign = uppercase hex HMAC-SHA256(app_secret, api_path + sorted name+value) and api_path excludes '/rest' ('HTTP request', https://openapi.alibaba.com/doc/doc.htm#/?docId=61). Object and array parameters are sent as JSON strings. Seller APIs are limited to Global Gold Supplier (GGS) sellers.

live_check.notes: requires app_key, app_secret, access_token; started, listed tools and answered a clean auth_error naming the variables
